name: Seven Eighty Three
description: Seven Eighty Three (Lab 783) is an independent systems laboratory and venture foundry.
thesis: We build bare-metal software, deterministic data schemas, and self-contained institutional architectures. Most digital infrastructure fails because it stacks third-party dependencies onto fragile commercial templates. We strip away decorative layers and build closed-loop systems from first principles.

architecture.lead: Structural indexing below the query layer.
architecture.description: Modern discovery happens inside autonomous parsers, language models, and semantic graphs before a human ever loads a viewport. Through the Universe API framework, 783 engineers zero-dependency HTML architectures, canonical JSON-LD graphs, and root-level machine directives (llms.txt) that make entities legible, verifiable, and deterministic.
architecture.framework: The Universe API is a macro-systems architecture and deterministic indexing framework operating below the query layer to govern structural indexing and deterministic data flow.

capabilities.name: Zero-Dependency Web Compilation
capabilities.description: Raw HTML and CSS define the document and Fibonacci spatial grid. Browser-native JavaScript handles state, Web Animations API motion, and observational navigation. Fonts and assets remain under the site’s control.

capabilities.name: Semantic Graph & Entity Resolution
capabilities.description: Canonical Schema.org JSON-LD identifies organizations, people, systems, and documents. Stable @id references connect the graph. BreadcrumbList and ItemList records expose page and section hierarchy.

capabilities.name: Organic Growth & Search Mechanics
capabilities.description: Discovery begins with crawlable documents, stable canonical URLs, and a taxonomy that preserves entity identity across domains. Structural crawl efficiency reduces ambiguity between the laboratory, its retained research assets, and its acquisition offers.

capabilities.name: Institutional Design Systems
capabilities.description: Typography, high-contrast palettes, spatial rules, and navigation encode institutional hierarchy. Fibonacci tokens and a 12-column reading slab govern scale and placement.

entities.name: Wild Lake Studio
entities.description: Brutalist talent architecture and structural design studio. Long-term stewardship, A&R, and sovereign career infrastructure for multidisciplinary artists. Retained asset (not for sale).

entities.name: Communal Foundation
entities.description: Civic and infrastructural research entity. Originator of the Food API specification, a standardized schema for nutritional, agricultural, and supply-chain interoperability. Specification available for acquisition.
entities.status: Specification available for acquisition. Not deployed.
entities.community_commitment: Part of the money the venture earns goes back to the communities it serves. The commitment scales with earnings and transfers with the venture to any acquirer.

entities.name: Point Zero
entities.description: Primary systems sandbox for testing zero-dependency, Fibonacci-scaled web compilers and bare-metal deployment protocols.

protocol: 783 does not operate as a creative agency, contractor, or billable vendor. We originate proprietary systems, incubate structural ventures, and enter select equity or architectural partnerships where foundational redesign is required. Direct inquiries to the intake ledger.

intake.delivery: Drafts an email in the visitor’s email app. Nothing is sent until the visitor sends it. No backend submission.
